purpose.summary: This program generates an alphabetical price list ('LISTA ALFABETICA DE PRECIOS') for articles, reading from indexed files (ART01, ART02, MARCAS, LINEAS, etc.), computing prices with and without VAT (IVA), and printing formatted output to IMP02. It also writes an intermediate indexed work file (PRELIS3) before printing.

verdict.notes: File is named LISPRE13.CBL but PROGRAM-ID is LISPRE8, suggesting version drift or copy/rename. Written in Argentina circa November 1991 for a PC-XT/AT environment.
